final: WITH joined AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.bandusagepct, o.weathprofile FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1), grp AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS n_telescopes FROM joined GROUP BY weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.weathprofile, g.avg_bw, g.n_telescopes, g.avg_bw - o.mean_avg AS deviation FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
